name: 3D Scroll Text Cylinder
description: Lines of text wrapped around an invisible 3D cylinder that rotates through depth as you scroll, with no WebGL required.
usage: Wrap .cyl-line spans in a [data-cylinder] element inside a .cyl-stage section, then call initScrollCylinder(); tune via data-radius, data-arc, data-spin and data-axis ("x" tube or "y" carousel). ScrollSmoother is optional and auto-detected for inertia.
